description: This file contains functions for generating initial values, updating values, and handling component schema in a document editor, specifically for component blocks and their properties.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Generates the initial value for a component block based on its schema and type.

methods.name: getInitialPropsValue
methods.description: Recursively generates initial property values based on a component schema.

methods.name: getInitialPropsValueFromInitializer
methods.description: Generates initial property values from an initializer, considering schema defaults.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.description: Updates a value based on a schema and an updater, handling nested structures and arrays.
